votes.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT d1.forename || ' ' || d1.surname AS driver_name
FROM drivers d1
JOIN results r1 ON d1.driverId = r1.driverId
JOIN races ra1 ON r1.raceId = ra1.raceId
WHERE d1.nationality = 'British'
  AND ra1.year BETWEEN 1990 AND 1999
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM drivers d2
      JOIN results r2 ON d2.driverId = r2.driverId
      WHERE d2.surname = d1.surname
        AND d2.driverId <> d1.driverId
  );

WITH volcanic_circuits AS (
  SELECT circuitId
  FROM circuits
  WHERE country IN ('Japan','Italy','Indonesia','Iceland','United States','Philippines','Mexico','Ecuador','Chile','Argentina','New Zealand','Costa Rica','Guatemala','Spain','France','Turkey','Kenya','Tanzania','Ethiopia')
     OR location LIKE '%Fuji%' OR location LIKE '%Etna%' OR location LIKE '%Vesuvius%' OR location LIKE '%Aso%' OR location LIKE '%Merapi%' OR location LIKE '%Krakatoa%' OR location LIKE '%Pinatubo%' OR location LIKE '%St.%Helens%' OR location LIKE '%Rainier%' OR location LIKE '%Hawaii%' OR location LIKE '%Teide%' OR location LIKE '%Pico%' OR location LIKE '%Mayon%' OR location LIKE '%Taal%'
),
volcanic_races AS (
  SELECT raceId
  FROM races
  WHERE circuitId IN (SELECT circuitId FROM volcanic_circuits)
),
pit_durations AS (
  SELECT p.driverId,
         CAST(p.duration AS REAL) AS duration_sec
  FROM pitStops p
  WHERE p.raceId IN (SELECT raceId FROM volcanic_races)
)
SELECT AVG(pd.duration_sec) AS avg_pit_stop_duration
FROM pit_durations pd
JOIN drivers d ON pd.driverId = d.driverId
GROUP BY d.nationality;
